title: Obadiah opening rem early
english: Rem early: Obadiah opening; historia and theoria toward Christ.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 71–72 Commentary on the Twelve Prophets (CPG 5204).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Hill FOTC wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill HC.
